summary: Full end-to-end testing of Chiste Studio AI. All 24 backend pytest tests pass (15 existing + 9 new heavy-flow tests covering voices, TTS, gpt-image-1 scene image, FFmpeg render, character image gen, costs). Frontend end-to-end flow verified via Playwright: language toggle (ES/EN), new project creation, AI joke generation, script/storyboard generation (4 scenes with editable fields), scene image generation (gpt-image-1, appeared in 9:16 VideoPreview), FFmpeg render completed with video player + download button, Characters CRUD (create + list + delete), Cost Tracker dialog.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby - a11y console warnings (not blocking)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to shadcn Dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: the historical elevenlabs /voices and /tts failures shown in Cost Tracker are stale (from earlier attempts). Consider adding a filter or resolve-all button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_project has a redundant list comprehension `[s if isinstance(s, dict) else s for s in updates['scenes']]` which is a no-op; harmless but should be removed.
server.py: /voices caches indefinitely in module-level _voice_cache; a stale/invalid key would be masked. Consider short TTL.
render.py silently trims scenes without images; the caller /projects/{id}/render already guards, so fine but could log a warning.
server.py cost_summary iterates full cost_events (limit 5000) each call; fine for MVP.
Frontend Studio.jsx generateImage/Audio call saveScenes(scenes) beforehand which is good, but errors from generateAll swallow individual scene errors silently - acceptable for MVP UX.
seed_data_creation: Test artifacts (TEST_ prefixed project, character) were cleaned up in fixtures / UI cleanup step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy-path flows verified. Backend test suite lives under /app/backend/tests/. test_full_flow.py requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var and runs real external APIs (~30s). Frontend Playwright covered: language-toggle-button, new-project-button, project-title-input, create-project-confirm-button, joke-generator-trigger, joke-result-text, generate-script-button, scene-card-0 with all editable inputs, regenerate-scene-image-button-0, tab-export, export-video-creatomate-button (triggers FFmpeg local render, not Creatomate), result-video-player, project-card-download-button, characters flow, cost-tracker-details-button.
